payload.title: Bounded IPC: source-only implementation plan (final written plan)
payload.design_basis: Medic v1..v5 packets + Rivet review deltas 20261011-01 (v2 review), v3 clarifications, v4 final delta, plan finalization. All corrections accepted and incorporated.

corrected_api.dwOpenMode: PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX plus explicitly chosen documented open flags
corrected_api.note: Pipe-mode flags live in dwPipeMode, never in dwOpenMode. Security-descriptor access masks (client: FILE_READ_DATA | FILE_WRITE_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE; server: full control) remain separate.
corrected_api.api: pywin32 (win32pipe.CreateNamedPipe + win32security DACL). Python multiprocessing connections explicitly excluded (recv() unpickles).

payload.reuse_boundary: dispatch.py is a thin ingress integration around the existing bound dispatch path and its Coordinator.gate. Not a second dispatch mechanism, not a second coordinator, not a separate gate. The reviewed route_owner_v7 adapter and Coordinator contract are reused as-is.

modules.frames.py: Length-prefixed bounded byte frames (4-byte big-endian length, 1,000,000-byte cap), strict canonical-JSON-v1 schema validation before any dispatch logic. Malformed frames dropped and logged. No pickle.
modules.journal.py: Append-only, fsynced, stable journal. Records: leases, admissions, revocations, uncertainty-holds, quiescence-evidence, intents, outcomes. Length-prefixed checksummed records. Loader is strictly fail-closed: ANY torn/unclassifiable/damaged record -> raise, refuse all verbs except status, enter full uncertainty hold. Original journal preserved byte-for-byte aside; recovery requires independent trusted reconciliation and explicit resumption — never automatic, never client-cleared, never re-seeded by setup.
modules.owner_ipc.py: Pipe server skeleton: exact dwOpenMode/dwPipeMode flags above, explicit least-privilege DACL (one owner SID full control; client SID read/write-data only). Per-connection SID/session observation via GetNamedPipeClientProcessId + token query; caller handles bound to observed SID at connect time. Same-account trust limit stated: DACL cannot separate same-user callers; caller handle is the only differentiator and is bearer.
modules.dispatch.py: Thin ingress: parses frames, holds Coordinator.gate continuously across the full sequence — caller/revocation check, lease+expiry check, approval/budget validation and reservation, write-ahead intent (fsync; failure = zero dispatch), backend invocation, outcome write (fsync; failure = uncertainty), final pre-dispatch expiry re-validation at the last possible moment. Lease transfer, revocation, and setup reconciliation acquire the SAME gate. Backend effects are not atomic; post-entry expiry is handled via uncertainty, not rollback promises.

payload.finite_owner_lifetime: Ends at earliest of: trusted setup stop, eight hours, 30 minutes with no active leases and no uncertainty holds, journal write failure.
acceptance_cases: zero_expired_starts: approval expires before final pre-dispatch boundary -> refused, zero backend effects.
uncertainty_without_duplicates: outcome write fails after backend effect -> restart sees uncertain intent, no replay, no duplicate under later fresh authority.
damaged_journal_fail_closed: any torn/damaged record on reload -> full uncertainty hold, all verbs refused except status, journal preserved aside.
partial_intent_bytes: torn trailing bytes never inferred as an intent; treated as damage per the rule above.
correct_gate: concurrent dispatch + lease transfer -> both serialize on Coordinator.gate, never interleave.
no_automatic_replay: quiescence evidence recorded; operation repeated only under separately valid fresh authority.
two_concurrent_one_action: exactly one backend effect; loser refused or queued.
damaged_evidence: checksum failure -> fail closed until trusted reconciliation.
payload.offline_test_form: Fake in-process transport. All cases above run against the real modules with a stub backend. No Windows host, no pipe creation, no DACL application, no live dispatch.

bounds.activation_separate_gate: Listener standup, DACL application, and live dispatch qualification require a separate future review and Bruce's explicit authorization.

payload.approval_requested: Freeze this plan and approve source-only implementation of the four modules + offline tests. Nothing runs until the activation gate is separately proposed, reviewed, and authorized.
payload.plan_closed: This file is the complete written plan. No further design rounds are needed before the owner decision.
